about_the_game:
Saddle up for a taste of adventure and creativity!


Jump into the whimsical world of Hobby Horse with this free Demo Version and discover the joy of DIY horse riding, obstacle courses, and endless customization—all from the comfort of your own room.

Create Your First Hobby Horse in the Demo Version

Start your journey by crafting your very own hobby horse! Choose from a selection of demo colors, shapes, and accessories to give your trusty steed a unique look. Show off your creativity and get ready to ride in style.

Tackle First Three Exciting Obstacle Courses in the Demo Version

Test your skills on a variety of demo obstacle courses, from cozy indoor gyms to challenging outdoor tracks. Run, jump, and leap over hurdles as you master the basics of hobby horse riding. Can you beat your best time and earn your first trophies?

Power Up and Leap Higher

Discover special boosters scattered across the demo courses! Grab a speed burst to dash past the competition or catch an air boost to soar over the tallest jumps. Experiment with different hobby horses to find the perfect balance of speed and jump height.

Personalize and Shine

Even in the demo, your hobby horse can stand out! Mix and match demo accessories and colors to create a look that’s all your own. Snap a screenshot of your creation and share your style with friends.

Hands-on Preview in the Demo Version - Experience the core gameplay of riding, jumping, and customizing your hobby horse.


Share your feedback and help us make Hobby Horse even better.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 780
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
